The play is printed straight through with no boxed insert, no sidebar and no out-of-sequence block interrupting it: (પ્રવેશ પહેલો) and the opening direction, the ભામાશા–જગડુ exchange, the warning with જગડુ's exit and ઉદો's entrance, the ઉદો scene ending on '(બંને ઊઠે છે)', then (પ્રવેશ બીજો) with પ્રતાપ's વિદાય, the offstage ડાબલા, and the climax closing on '(સહુ મેવાડનો જય ગજાવે છે. પડદો પડે છે.)'.

Not in this list, because they are not this chapter's teaching text: the teacher-addressed blue પ્રવેશપેટી on p. 93, the શબ્દાર્થ box on p. 95, and the twelve numbered સ્વાધ્યાય blocks on pp. 96–98.
